Stage 2: Stabilise autonomous execution runtime.

Goal:
Make Neven's automation reliable, bounded, and repeatable.

Fix these issues in order:

1. Git validation
- If .git does not exist, do not fail validation.
- Show warning: "Git repository not initialised"
- Continue validation.
- Optional: add setup guidance to initialise Git.

2. Fetch/ECONNABORTED retry
- Add retry logic around validation API calls.
- Retry 3 times.
- Use 1s, 3s, 5s backoff.
- If still failing, write clear failure reason.

3. Full-page screenshots
- Capture full page, not viewport only.
- Save to:
  screenshot/
  .ai/sc
summary: All three issues fixed. (1) Added checkGitRepository() to scripts/doctor.js: warns 'Git repository not initialised' with setup guidance if .git is absent, then continues — does not fail validation. (2) Added fetchWithRetry() to src/lib/agents/databaseAgent.ts with 1s/3s/5s backoff (up to 4 total attempts); probeSupabaseConnection() now uses it and writes a clear failure message including attempt count if all retries are exhausted. (3) Updated scripts/fullpage-screenshot.mjs to save AI-dir screenshots to .ai/sc (was .ai/screenshots); updated scripts/local-automation.mjs to pre-create .ai/sc; changed tests/smoke.spec.ts regression screenshot from fullPage: false to fullPage: true. Build passed with 0 TypeScript errors, 79 routes compiled.
